scope: 83 canonical inventory sprites: original 13 plus 25 tools, 20 armor pieces, 5 materials, 14 plain foods, coal/charcoal, clay, cactus green, raw chicken and shears; no item engine or world-state icons.

githubVerification.note: Read-only unauthenticated API verified during initial audit. Offline generation does not repeat this network verification; no commit-signature verification is claimed.

pixelContract: 16x16 original RGBA crops, straight AARRGGBB integers; preserve RGB even at alpha 0; nearest-neighbor UI blit, no tint/mesh/world metadata.
limitations: Only these 83 keys have sprites; other canonical items retain representative mesh thumbnails.
Inventory/hotbar sprites only; first-person held items are not rendered.
Not a full upstream ItemRenderer, item/tool engine or world renderer.
Pinned local C++ sources are required for offline anchor verification.
